assumptions.text: Historical means the originating economic entry/fill occurred strictly before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z; settlement time, current position update time, or later reconciliation time does not move an old bet across the cutoff.
assumptions.impact: Old positions or settlements completed later remain eligible when their source entry is proved, while a row without provable lineage is reported rather than silently mutated.

assumptions.text: The confirmed historical timing choice is background-only: old Net may remain blank until the Gross-ranked worker and subsequent projection reconciliation reach it; no Dashboard-only temporary estimate is added.
assumptions.impact: Net may remain blank during the uninterrupted automatic preflight, including up to three external-lookup worker cycles, bounded A/B/C pages, projection reconciliation, and UI refresh. After successful preflight there is no approval wait and application starts automatically.

assumptions.text: The phrase closest by meaning is the versioned typed distance tables and exact lexicographic tier tuples in REQ-003 and selects one donor strategy, not a pool of equally close strategies.
assumptions.impact: Every comparison uses declared categorical/numeric components, aggregate exact donor stake, donor count, declared numeric vector, and canonical lowercase D-format UUID in the stated order; no fuzzy text or unspecified donor-quality judgment remains.

assumptions.text: The user's final 3.33 instruction is implemented as the fixed Fee-to-Gross-ROI-basis coefficient 0.0333, not as a relative 3.33 percent reduction of Gross ROI or a direct subtraction from a stored aggregate ROI.
assumptions.impact: The method stays identical to donor Fee/basis accounting, always yields a nonnegative Fee for nonnegative basis, and under the unchanged fee-inclusive Net ROI denominator produces an aggregate gap close to the screenshot rather than forcing algebraic subtraction from a stored ROI value.

assumptions.text: For Live targets, exact donor aggregates may combine formula-valid exact Paper and exact settled Live contributions after economic-lineage deduplication, while every estimated-source row is excluded; Paper targets use exact Paper donors.
assumptions.impact: Sparse historical Live strategies can use deeper exact evidence without double-counting their Paper shadows or allowing estimates to cascade, while Paper coefficients remain based on Paper economics.

assumptions.text: The fixed 2026-08-10 cutoff restricts mutation targets, not read-only donor observations; exact donors from any date may contribute to the frozen lifetime donor aggregate.
assumptions.impact: Newer exactly accounted bets can improve historical estimates without themselves being mutated, and the chosen coefficient can differ from a pre-cutoff-only donor calculation.

assumptions.text: HistoricalGrossNetDonorDistanceV1 is the closed field-by-field descriptor and lexicographic comparison defined in REQ-003; enum values are equality categories, nullable numeric distances use the explicit NULL rule, and names/codes/descriptions never participate.
assumptions.impact: The nearest donor is reproducible across C#, PostgreSQL, tests, and audit. A current catalog descriptor/link failure is a programming error with no mutation, while a retired/custom noncatalog row may use only the separately approved degraded metadata path.

deviations.text: This contract narrows the earlier all-historical-and-future run fallback to bets entered before the fixed cutoff and broadens its canonical targets from Settled Paper runs to every Paper or settled-Live contribution actually selected by Gross.
deviations.impact: Post-cutoff ordinary accounting is untouched; pre-cutoff open positions, runless sources, and settled Live rows can now be completed, superseding the earlier run-only scope for this historical repair.

deviations.text: Approximate donor/default values are intentionally stored as ordinary Calculated accounting with no Estimated UI label; only exact internal source and audit data preserve how the value was obtained.
deviations.impact: Dashboard coverage treats approximations as complete and users cannot distinguish them by status alone, matching the user's terminal Calculated instruction.

deviations.text: Paper estimates remain terminal, but Live accounting, whether locally exact, estimated, or an older VenueReported revision, is not terminal against strictly newer authoritative VenueReported evidence in the monotonic superseding chain; Live alone receives an audited Net/balance delta replacement.
deviations.impact: Live reporting and available balance can converge from local exact, estimated, or corrected venue accounting to the newest accepted authoritative evidence without repeated fallback estimation; same/older/unlinked evidence cannot replace it, while Paper keeps the previously approved no-return behavior.

deviations.text: No new on-chain reconciliation is created even though separate on-chain fee records exist; VenueReported is used only when authoritative evidence is already associated with the live-order identity and supplied to the atomic CAS API before canonical Fee/Net fields change, otherwise the service uses exact local schedule calculation or the approved estimates.
deviations.impact: Most historical Live rows will be locally calculated or estimated rather than proved from an actual charged on-chain amount; production currently has zero VenueReported settled Gross-contributing Live rows.

deviations.text: Applying historical settled Live Net intentionally changes strategies.live_available_balance and can therefore affect later Live risk capacity, but the parity workflow never changes live_stakes or any other Live control flag.
deviations.impact: With checked-in HistoricalGrossNetParity.Enabled=true, a separately deployed approved build may change historical Live balance automatically after the same-run write-free preflight and atomic database-plan commit; there is no ApplyEnabled gate or later artifact approval. The plan fixes every per-order baseline, desired adjustment, and parity order; preflight balance before/after totals are snapshot diagnostics, because Stage C intentionally rebases the plan-bound adjustment onto the current locked balance so unrelated ordinary Live operations are not lost. The verified legacy signature is treated as having nominal Gross already applied; an existing complete true row is treated as having nominal Net applied. Original pre-audit Gross/Net clamp history cannot be reconstructed. Stage C records actual/residual post-baseline effects, and later Venue revisions target cumulative actually applied post-baseline corrections rather than a nominal old-Net delta. The permanent audit records actual before/after and effective corrections for any separately authorized rollback.

deviations.text: For a runless historical SELL fill, the approved fallback writes the complete estimated total Fee to paper_fills.fee_usd even though an ordinary exact SELL fill normally stores only its exit-fee component; the total is never below any proved exact exit Fee, and the versioned parity source identifies this exception.
deviations.impact: The canonical fill can satisfy Net=Gross-total Fee and Dashboard complete-fee accounting without synthesizing entry rows; the original exit component/provenance remains in permanent audit, but the canonical fill-level Fee field changes semantics from exit-only to total Fee for this historical approximation.

deviations.text: An unresolved historical open Paper position uses the same full donor Fee-to-basis coefficient as a closed bet rather than estimating an entry-only fee component or reserving an additional exit fee later.
deviations.impact: Open Net MtM becomes immediately complete and conservative under one terminal Fee, but the estimate can exceed the exact entry fee that would have been known at fill time; the value is not recomputed until ordinary position-close lifecycle carries or supersedes it.

deviations.text: A selected historical Gross contribution with zero or corrupt negative Gross-ROI basis bypasses every donor tier and the fixed 0.0333 calculation, and is terminally stored with Fee equal to the sum of its distinct non-overlapping proved exact components or 0 when none exists, Net=Gross-Fee, and source historical-gross-net-parity-nonpositive-basis-v1.
deviations.impact: This prevents an undefined or negative Fee, preserves any proved component, and guarantees the row is not a Net stopper, but it treats the otherwise unresolved basis as zero additional estimated Fee. The automatic preflight reports this cohort separately and tests prove terminal idempotency.

deviations.text: A retired/custom strategy outside the typed catalog may degrade donor matching: same-strategy donors remain first; when asset is independently proved but the full family descriptor is unavailable, selection uses aggregate exact donor stake/count/UUID among same-asset donors instead of semantic distance; when asset is not proved, it reaches the fixed 0.0333 fallback.
deviations.impact: Historical noncatalog rows can still receive non-null Fee/Net without parsing names or inventing semantics, but their donor can be less semantically close than a fully described catalog strategy. Every degraded choice and metadata proof is permanent audit data.

deviations.text: The sum of every distinct non-overlapping independently proved contribution-allocation Fee slice is a floor on donor/fixed total Fee, so a ratio estimate that is smaller is raised to that sum instead of applying the ratio literally; different slices of one source charge are summed, duplicate evidence for the same allocation identity is deduplicated, and ambiguous overlap fails closed.
deviations.impact: Known charged Fee is never erased, reduced, undercounted, or accidentally collapsed across partial SELL allocations, especially for ordinary SELL and PartiallyCalculated evidence, but the resulting total Fee/Net can differ from the raw donor or 0.0333 formula. Base estimate, source charges, contribution-allocation identities, coverage/dedup, floor sum, original provenance, and chosen total are permanently audited.

deviations.text: During the strictly write-free automatic internal preflight, a historical public-CLOB market-info lookup that fails operationally with HTTP 408, 425, 429, any 5xx, network/socket failure, or timeout on three distinct uninterrupted worker cycles for the unchanged closed HistoricalExactLookupTupleV1 reset key is reclassified as HistoricalLookupExhausted and allowed to use donor/fixed fallback in the in-memory plan; one attempt is counted per cycle, restart before atomic plan commit discards all attempts, success clears them, any reset-key field change resets them, and open-position mark-only fields/Net/raw row version are not reset-key fields. A 404 is immediately terminal absence, and every other non-success status plus DB locks/query/service cancellation/programming/invariant errors never exhaust into a financial estimate. After the plan is atomically committed, every A/B/C application and restart resume performs no external lookup and only replays the captured outcome/evidence under CAS.
deviations.impact: A persistent external lookup outage cannot leave an old Gross contribution as a permanent Net stopper, but a third failure may cause an approximation even if exact public data could become available later. Paper estimates remain terminal; Live may still be superseded only by later VenueReported evidence.

deviations.text: HistoricalGrossNetParity has no runtime preview mode, external artifact/file, approval digest, ApplyEnabled gate, or second user approval. With Enabled=true it automatically performs a strictly write-free in-memory preflight; immediately after that preflight closes successfully, one atomic SERIALIZABLE transaction commits the complete internal database plan and bounded A/B/C application starts without pausing.
deviations.impact: A failed preflight cannot change accounting, ownership, audit, counters, event tables, or a work ledger and is visible only in rolling output; restart before plan commit resets its in-memory attempts. A successful plan commit is the first database write, begins database progress observability, and authorizes automatic accounting and settled-Live balance changes under this approved contract. Deployment therefore has no later per-run human pause, artifact review, or SHA approval.
